sentence: Ask someone to name [what art is built from](/elements-of-art/) and they will usually reach for the same seven words that the elements-of-art guide on this site finds in a 1968 printing of a studio-art textbook, the earliest copy it could document: line, shape, form, space, value, color, texture.
